title: Murder of Neeraj Grover
narrative: FIR — 7 May 2008, Mumbai. Neeraj Grover, a 26-year-old television executive, was stabbed to death with a kitchen knife. The accused were Maria Susairaj, an actress, and her fiance Lieutenant Emile Jerome Mathew, a naval officer. The body was dismembered, placed in bags, taken to a forest near Manor in Maharashtra and burned with petrol. The Mumbai Crime Branch investigated; mobile-phone location tracing to Manor contradicted the alibi and the knife was recovered from a garbage chute. Mathew was convicted of culpable homicide and Susairaj of destroying evidence.
